symptom: A custom error handler on a Send REST request activity (Microflows$RestOperationCallAction) was lost both ways: describe of a Studio Pro microflow printed no `on error` block, and `send rest request … on error [without rollback] begin … end error` passed check, exec reported the microflow created, and the BSON held ErrorHandlingType Rollback with no error flow and none of the handler's activities.
cause: A deliberate exclusion in three places (getActionErrorHandlingType, formatRestOperationCallAction, addSendRestRequestAction) on the strength of a comment saying Mendix refuses a custom handler there with CE6035. It was never measured; the #1078 finding repeated it as fact, and two skills taught it. The writer also never wrote ErrorHandlingType at all. Only `continue` is CE6035.
fix: Builder sets explicitErrorHandling and wires finishCustomErrorHandler; writer emits ErrorHandlingType (default Rollback, as before); describe no longer excludes the action; MDL076 refuses `on error continue` on it. Skills rest-client and write-microflows corrected.
insight: A CE number in a code comment is a claim, not a measurement — this one silently deleted handlers for months. Measured on 10.24.11, 11.12.6 and 11.16.1 in one script of four microflows (no clause, custom, custom without rollback, continue): exactly one CE6035, and removing the continue microflow gives 0 errors. Round trip: describe -> exec reports unchanged; create-or-modify exec twice writes nothing.
test: mdl/executor/microflow_rest_error_handler_2534_test.go (builder, describe, MDL076 with controls), mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_rest_error_handling_2534_test.go (writer, no-clause control)
